question.text: Portfolio return 10.5%, risk-free 5.5%, sigma 6.5%. Sharpe ratio (approx):

explanation.text: The Logic: Sharpe ratio = (portfolio return - risk-free rate) / standard deviation = (10.50% - 5.50%) / 6.50% = 5 / 6.5 = 0.7692, which rounds to 0.77. The Trap: The other values arise from arithmetic errors in the numerator or denominator. Note: This is the exact workbook example used to illustrate the Sharpe ratio formula.
